# miragea-skills

> Open-source Agent Skills (SKILL.md folders) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents that add voiceover, captions and video-narration abilities, powered by the Miragea voice and speech-recognition API (https://miragea.ai/v1). Python standard library + ffmpeg; MIT licensed.

## Skills
- [video-captions](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/video-captions): caption any video or audio into readable SRT/VTT (whole words, 42-char lines) and burn captions into MP4, including 1-3 word Shorts/Reels/TikTok captions. `python3 scripts/captions.py input.mp4 --burn`
- [remotion-narration](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/remotion-narration): script to per-scene voiceover MP3s, measured durations as Remotion durationInFrames, word-level Remotion Caption[] JSON and SRT. `python3 scripts/narrate.py script.md --voice VOICE_ID`

- [screen-recording-voiceover](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/screen-recording-voiceover): add a timed AI voiceover to a silent screen recording; finds steps, voices one line per step, auto speed-up or freeze-frame when a line runs long, ducked music, SRT/VTT, burned captions. `python3 scripts/voiceover.py demo.mp4 demo.script.txt --voice VOICE_ID`
- [shorts-voiceover](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/shorts-voiceover): text script to a finished 1080x1920 YouTube Short / TikTok / Reel with voiceover, captions timed from the real speech, Ken Burns images or B-roll or gradients, ducked music, -14 LUFS. `python3 scripts/short.py script.txt --voice VOICE_ID`

## Facts
- Requires MIRAGEA_API_KEY (environment variable). Keys are never printed or stored.
- Captions cost 3 Miragea points per audio second; speech is billed per character; cached re-runs are free.
- Voice: a saved Miragea voice id, or a public reference clip URL (with consent).
- Install: `npx skills add yyert123/miragea-skills` or copy a skill folder into your agent's skills directory.
